name: ClickFix 'fix this error' lure page
description: Web page that copies a shell command to the clipboard and tells the visitor to paste it into the Windows Run dialog or a terminal to 'fix' a fake browser crash, missing font/extension, audio-driver or update error (ClickFix variants: CrashFix, GlitchFix, fake Google Meet audio fix). The user, not malware, launches the command. A saved tech-support tutorial with a copy button can look the same, so verify the page.
condition: clip and keys and cmd and fix

name: ClickFix lure targeting Windows Terminal (Win+X)
description: Lure page that writes a command to the clipboard and instructs Win+X then I (Windows Terminal), a launch surface that evades detections written only for the Run dialog (seen in Microsoft-reported February 2026 campaigns).
condition: clip and winx and term and ps

name: FileFix lure (command hidden behind a fake file path)
description: Lure page that copies a command padded with spaces and a decoy 'C:\...' path so that, pasted into the File Explorer address bar of a 'choose file' dialog, only the harmless-looking path is visible. No file is downloaded, so Mark-of-the-Web never applies.

name: finger.exe used to fetch a script (ClickFix/CrashFix)
description: Command that pipes the output of the legacy 'finger' client to a shell, or copies finger.exe to a renamed executable. Used by KongTuke and CrashFix chains since late 2025; finger has no legitimate use on modern PCs.

name: nslookup used as a DNS payload stager
description: Command that queries an attacker-chosen DNS server with nslookup, filters the 'Name:' answer and pipes it to a shell (DNS-based ClickFix variant reported by Microsoft in February 2026).

name: SyncAppvPublishingServer.vbs abused to run a download command
description: Command that abuses the signed App-V helper SyncAppvPublishingServer to run PowerShell download/execute stages (ClearFake and Amatera ClickFix chains, January 2026).

name: PowerShell iex(irm <raw IP>) one-liner
description: PowerShell one-liner that downloads and immediately executes content from a raw public IP address (iex(irm 'IP:port/path' -UseBasicParsing)), the stage-one command in Google/Cloudflare fake-verification ClickFix pages.

name: mshta launched against a remote URL
description: mshta executing an HTA or script directly from an http(s) URL, including disguised double extensions such as '.hta.mp4'. Common ClickFix stage and malvertising payload runner.

name: ClickFix stage-one downloader artefacts (ProgramData\Zooms, dl-callback)
description: Script artefacts documented in July 2026 fake Google/Cloudflare verification chains: a staging folder under ProgramData named Zooms and a '/dl-callback' beacon issued by PowerShell.

name: Infostealer with Chrome app-bound-encryption bypass
description: Executable or script combining the Chrome app-bound key name (app_bound_encrypted_key) with elevation-service COM access, DevTools cookie debugging or CookieMonster memory scanning, plus crypto-wallet / messenger targeting strings. This is the technique StealC, Vidar, Lumma, MetaStealer and Phemedrone use to defeat ABE.
condition: abe and (svc or clsid or dbg or cm) and 2 of (w1,w2,w3,w4,w5)

name: Stealer harvesting cookies through the Chrome DevTools Protocol
description: Executable that launches a browser with remote debugging, optionally headless or off-screen, and calls Network.getAllCookies while also touching the 'Login Data' store (Phemedrone-style ABE bypass).

name: Stealer resolving C2 from Steam profile and Telegram pages
description: Executable that embeds Steam community profile and Telegram channel URLs next to browser-credential store names, the dead-drop C2 resolution pattern used by Vidar.

name: Stealer exfiltrating browser/wallet data to a Telegram bot
description: Program that references the Telegram Bot API sendDocument method together with the names of browser credential, cookie or wallet stores it archives and uploads.

name: Amber Albatross installer arguments (--safetorun / --channel)
description: Installer or Pyarmor-protected PyInstaller payload that requires the --safetorun and --channel=<hex> arguments. Red Canary's most prevalent 2025 threat: PUP 'app store' and fake PDF-tool installers with stealer-like recon.

name: JustAskJacky AI-helper / manual-reader trojan installer
description: Installer or script carrying the lure names of JustAskJacky, a trojan posing as an AI chatbot or manual reader that runs obfuscated Node.js beacons with remote eval(). Signed InnoSetup installers, often revoked certificates.

name: Scheduled task running Node.js/Deno script from a user-writable folder
description: Script that registers a scheduled task running node or deno against a JavaScript file in AppData, ProgramData, Public or Temp: the persistence pattern of JustAskJacky, TonRAT and Deno-based RATs.

name: ModeloRAT / portable-Python implant persistence
description: Script artefacts of the CrashFix payload: a bundled WinPython running pythonw against modes.py or udp.pyw, persistence through a Run key or a task named SoftwareProtection that fires every few minutes.
condition: (modes and pyw) or (udp and (pers or pyw)) or (wpy and pyw and pers) or (swp and pers and (pyw or udp))

name: CrashFix fake uBlock Origin Lite extension indicators
description: Files referencing the extension ID or tracking domain of the malicious uBlock Origin Lite clone that crashes the browser and then serves a ClickFix 'repair' command (Microsoft, February 2026).

name: Browser extension script polling and exfiltrating cookies
description: Extension background script that enumerates cookies with cookies.getAll, on a timer, and sends them over the network. Matches the session-hijacking extensions reported by Socket in 2026; some legitimate cookie-sync tools behave similarly, so verify the extension.

name: Extension manifest combining cookie access, all-site access and native/debugger channels
description: manifest.json requesting cookies, access to all sites and either nativeMessaging or debugger. The June 2026 session-theft campaign used a native messaging host to run PowerShell. Audit-level signal: password managers also use nativeMessaging.
condition: mv and ck and allsites and (nat or dbg)

name: Script silently force-installing a browser extension via policy
description: PowerShell/batch/registry script that writes the Chrome or Edge ExtensionInstallForcelist policy while hiding its window or downloading content. Malware uses this so the extension looks administrator-managed.
condition: fl and pol and wr and stealth

name: Native messaging host manifest that launches a shell or script
description: Browser native-messaging host manifest whose path points at PowerShell, cmd or a script file instead of a compiled helper, letting an extension execute local code (used in the June 2026 Chrome session-cookie campaign).

name: ResiLoader / StealC chain markers
description: Executable carrying the AtLorenBase marker used by the msys-crypto DLL side-loading loader that unpacks StealC and kills security processes, or its documented C2 domain (Malwarebytes, July 2026).

name: JavaScript resolving payloads from blockchain smart contracts (EtherHiding)
description: Script combining an eth_call JSON-RPC request to a public chain endpoint with eval and base64 decoding, used by ClearFake and malicious npm packages to fetch the next stage from a smart contract.
condition: call and rpc and ev and b64

name: JavaScript decoding hidden zero-width characters into code
description: Script that holds zero-width space/non-joiner characters (raw or as \u200b / \u200c escapes), decodes them (binary parseInt or fromCharCode) and evaluates the result. Technique of the Tampered Chef Electron trojans.
condition: ((za and zb) or (ea and eb)) and dec and ev

name: SmartLoader/FakeGit one-line batch launcher for a renamed LuaJIT
description: One-line .bat/.cmd that detaches a renamed LuaJIT interpreter (loader, selector, unit, load, compiler, util, luajit, boot) against an obfuscated Lua payload stored as .txt or .log. Delivered in ZIPs from fake GitHub repositories (game cheats, mod menus, AI and developer tools); about two thirds of URLhaus online URLs on 2026-10-15 were raw.githubusercontent.com ZIPs tagged SmartLoader.

name: Lua stage using FFI to hide its console, allocate memory or resolve C2 from a blockchain contract
description: Lua script that loads the FFI library, declares Win32 prototypes (GetConsoleWindow, ShowWindow, VirtualAlloc/CreateThread) or queries a Polygon contract with eth_call to learn its C2 address. Second stage of SmartLoader that delivers StealC, Rhadamanthys or Lumma.
condition: addr or (ffi and con and show and alloc) or (ffi and call and (drpc or sel))

name: Scheduled task running a renamed interpreter from LocalAppData against a .txt/.log payload
description: schtasks /create whose action is an .exe under LocalAppData followed by a .txt or .log argument, or one of the decoy task names seen in the April 2026 SmartLoader/StealC campaign (two daily tasks, one cached copy and one that re-fetches the payload from GitHub).
condition: n1 or n2 or (create and tr)

name: Script excluding broad paths or executable types from Microsoft Defender
description: Add-MpPreference / Set-MpPreference call that excludes a drive root, Users, ProgramData, Temp, AppData, or whole extensions such as .exe. Used by ClickFix, SEO-poisoning and RAT chains so the payload is never scanned.

name: Script writing Microsoft Defender exclusions directly in the registry
description: Registry commands or .reg content targeting Windows Defender\Exclusions\Paths/Extensions/Processes, an alternative to Add-MpPreference that avoids PowerShell logging.

name: Script that turns off Microsoft Defender protection
description: Commands disabling real-time/behaviour monitoring, setting DisableAntiSpyware, uninstalling the Defender feature or stopping WinDefend/Sense. Ransomware, miners and crack installers run these before dropping payloads.

name: PowerShell AMSI bypass
description: Script that sets amsiInitFailed through reflection, or reflects into AmsiUtils / patches AmsiScanBuffer so later stages run unscanned.
condition: fail or (utils and ref) or (scan and patch)

name: Script disabling .NET or native ETW tracing
description: PowerShell/script that flips the EventProvider m_enabled field or patches EtwEventWrite/NtTraceEvent to blind event tracing used by EDR.

name: Scheduled task that runs a script host from a user-writable folder
description: schtasks /create registering a task whose action lives in AppData, ProgramData, Public or Temp and is a script host or interpreter, run every few minutes or hidden/encoded. Matches the RAT persistence reported by Kaspersky (every two minutes) and Microsoft (every five minutes).
condition: create and dir and host and (freq or stealth)

name: Run/RunOnce autostart launching an interpreter or hidden PowerShell
description: Script adding a Run or RunOnce value that starts pythonw, node, deno, wscript, cscript or mshta from a user folder, or hidden/encoded PowerShell. Seen with ModeloRAT, TonRAT and Deno RAT chains.

name: WMI permanent event subscription persistence
description: Script or MOF defining an __EventFilter bound to a CommandLineEventConsumer/ActiveScriptEventConsumer, a fileless persistence mechanism that Microsoft ships an ASR rule for.

name: Per-user COM class hijack pointing at a script or user-folder DLL
description: Registry commands or .reg content that create HKCU\Software\Classes\CLSID\{...}\InprocServer32/LocalServer32/TreatAs/ScriptletURL entries pointing at AppData, ProgramData, Temp, Public, scrobj.dll or an .sct file.
condition: cls and hive and wr and tgt

name: UAC bypass through ms-settings / mscfile shell\open\command hijack
description: Registry edit of Classes\ms-settings or mscfile \shell\open\command (DelegateExecute) so fodhelper, computerdefaults or eventvwr launch an attacker command with elevated rights.
condition: key and wr and (deleg or bin)

name: UAC bypass via the ICMLuaUtil / CMSTPLUA COM elevation moniker
description: Executable or script referencing ICMLuaUtil, the CMSTPLUA CLSID or the Elevation:Administrator!new: moniker. ResiLoader and several ransomware families use it to elevate silently.

name: BITS job with a notify command line
description: bitsadmin creating a job that downloads a remote file and runs a command on completion (SetNotifyCmdLine), a long-standing download and persistence trick.

name: Script weakening UAC or remote token filtering
description: Registry commands that set ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin or EnableLUA to 0 or LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy to 1, observed in fake-software-site RAT chains that 'disable UAC prompts'.

name: Script rebooting into Safe Mode
description: bcdedit forcing safeboot followed by a restart. Used to run encryptors or EDR killers while security tools are not loaded; Microsoft ships an ASR rule against it.

name: Hidden-window PowerShell download-and-execute
description: PowerShell that downloads text and passes it to Invoke-Expression in a hidden window. Official installer one-liners (uv, Scoop, Chocolatey) do not hide the window.

name: Script killing or deleting many security product processes and services
description: taskkill / sc / net stop / Stop-Service commands aimed at several named security products (Defender, SentinelOne, CrowdStrike, Bitdefender, ESET, Kaspersky, Sophos, Cylance, Elastic, Malwarebytes, Avast, Tanium). ESET counts script-based killers among ransomware affiliates' pre-encryption tooling.

name: Kernel driver service created from a user-writable path (BYOVD)
description: sc create ... binPath=<temp/user path>\*.sys type=kernel, the exact loader pattern shown in LOLDrivers entries for abused vulnerable or malicious drivers, used by EDR killers.

name: Script combining several backup/recovery destruction commands
description: Two or more of: vssadmin delete shadows or resize shadowstorage, wmic shadowcopy delete, PowerShell Win32_Shadowcopy removal (as in the CISA Akira advisory), bcdedit recoveryenabled no, wbadmin delete, reagentc /disable.

name: Double-extortion ransom note text
description: Text or HTML note that combines a Tor onion address, a claim that data was stolen/exfiltrated, a threat to publish or sell it, decryption/recovery language and a negotiation or chat channel.
condition: onion and dec and stolen and (leak or chat)

name: Cryptominer configuration or launcher (Monero wallet, pool, miner flags)
description: Script, config or binary pairing a Monero wallet address with a known mining pool domain or miner command-line flags (--donate-level, --coin monero, rx/0). Cryptojackers are often dropped by cracked-software installers.

name: Shortcut launching encoded or downloading PowerShell
description: Windows shortcut whose target arguments run PowerShell with an encoded command or FromBase64String, a download cradle combined with Invoke-Expression, or a hidden window combined with a download/execute call. Delivery format of the June 2026 'photo ZIP' campaign (IMG-<digits>.png.lnk).
condition: ps and (m1 or m2 or m8 or (m6 and (m3 or m4 or m5 or i1 or i2 or i3)) or ((m3 or m4) and (m5 or i1 or i2 or i3)))

name: Shortcut running a LOLBin against a remote URL
description: Shortcut whose target runs mshta, curl, certutil or bitsadmin with an http(s) URL.

name: HTA application that runs commands or downloads files
description: HTML Application using WScript.Shell/Shell.Application to Run or Exec a command, with PowerShell, XMLHTTP / ADODB.Stream download objects or string obfuscation.
condition: hta and sh and run and (cmd or dl or obf)

name: JScript/VBScript downloader that saves and runs a file
description: Windows Script Host script that fetches content with XMLHTTP/WinHttp, writes it with ADODB.Stream and executes it through WScript.Shell. SocGholish-, Gootloader- and ClickFix-stage scripts use this shape.
condition: http and stream and sh and run

name: MSBuild project with an inline task that downloads, loads or injects code
description: MSBuild project/targets file with a CodeTaskFactory/RoslynCodeTaskFactory inline task that uses VirtualAlloc, Assembly.Load, FromBase64String, DownloadString or launches a process. MSBuild.exe run from AppData was used in a 2026 ClickFix chain.

name: package.json install hook that downloads or evals code
description: preinstall/install/postinstall script that calls curl, wget, PowerShell, certutil, node -e, eval or pipes to a shell. The Shai-Hulud worm family and many typosquats abuse lifecycle hooks; legitimate packages normally run a local script or node-gyp.

name: Script that harvests npm/GitHub/cloud tokens and republishes packages
description: JavaScript that reads .npmrc and cloud/GitHub token variables, talks to the npm publish API and exfiltrates to webhook.site, or carries the 'Shai-Hulud: Here We Go Again' repository marker. Behaviour of the Shai-Hulud self-replicating npm worm described by CISA.
condition: mark or (rc and pub and tok and hook)

name: Network indicators from the 2026 Keyv/ChainDrop npm compromise
description: Files referencing domains listed in Singapore CSA advisory AD-2026-009 for the self-propagating npm package compromise (exfiltration and mirror domains).

name: setup.py that executes decoded or downloaded code on install
description: setup.py that calls exec/eval on base64/zlib-decoded or network-fetched data, or shells out to PowerShell/curl from a custom install command. Typical of malicious PyPI packages targeting developers.

name: PHP web shell executing request input
description: PHP file that passes request parameters (optionally base64/gzip/rot13 decoded) to eval, assert, system, shell_exec, passthru, exec, popen or proc_open.

name: ASPX web shell running commands or loading code from request data
description: ASP.NET page that reads a request parameter and starts a process, calls cmd/PowerShell or loads a base64 assembly.
condition: page and req and (proc or asm)

name: OneNote file embedding an executable or script
description: OneNote (.one) file containing a FileDataStoreObject plus an embedded PE header, script host or batch content. Microsoft blocks the common embedded types by default since 2023, but the format remains a delivery vector (Emotet, QakBot, AsyncRAT campaigns).

fds.hex: E7 16 E3 BD 65 26 11 45 A4 C4 8D 4D 0B 7A 9E AC

mz.text: This program cannot be run in DOS mode

condition: fds and (mz or wsh or bat)
